headline: Brazilian Senate Approves Bill Creating Credit Lines for Tariffs-Affected Firms
summary: The Brazilian Senate approved a bill resulting from Provisional Measure 1.379/2026 to create R$ 22.6 billion in subsidized credit lines for companies impacted by U.S. tariff surcharges.
why: Subsidized government credit programs aim to cushion domestic industries against external trade barriers and tariff shocks.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Legislative approval of R$ 22.6 billion in credit supports Brazilian firms facing U.S. tariffs.
